reviewPlot: After catching up with the mischievous youths, you rescued the injured Magikarp and temporarily captured it in a Pokéball.

reviewPlot: After solving the desert mystery, you found a beautiful Milotic statue.
reviewPlot_vn: Sau khi giải quyết được bí ẩn trong sa mạc, các bạn đã tìm thấy một bức tượng Milotic tuyệt đẹp.
reviewPlot_en: After solving the desert mystery, you found a beautiful Milotic statue.
reviewPlot_th: หลังจากไขปริศนาในทะเลทราย คุณได้พบรูปปั้นมิโลติกที่สวยงาม
reviewPlot_in: Setelah memecahkan misteri gurun, kamu menemukan patung Milotic yang indah
reviewPlot_ph: Matapos malutas ang misteryo sa disyerto, natagpuan ninyo ang isang magandang rebultong Milotic
reviewPlot_ma: Selepas menyelesaikan misteri padang pasir, anda menjumpai patung Milotic yang cantik

desc_en: Level Effect: Be careful not to let the Milotic statue be destroyed. Victory Condition: Win in one turn and keep the Milotic statue intact
desc_th: เอฟเฟกต์ระดับ: ระวังอย่าให้รูปปั้น Milotic พัง เงื่อนไขชนะ: ชนะภายใน 1 เทิร์นและรูปปั้น Milotic ไม่แตก

reviewPlot: The Milotic statue was stolen by Team Rocket, and during the retrieval process, you unfortunately fell from the plane…
reviewPlot_vn: Bức tượng Milotic đã bị Team Rocket cướp đi, trong quá trình lấy lại bức tượng Milotic, các bạn không may bị ngã khỏi máy bay…
reviewPlot_en: The Milotic statue was stolen by Team Rocket, and during the retrieval process, you unfortunately fell from the plane…
reviewPlot_th: รูปปั้นมิโลติกถูกขโมยไปโดยทีมร็อกเก็ต และระหว่างการนำกลับ คุณโชคร้ายตกจากเครื่องบิน...
reviewPlot_in: Patung Milotic telah dicuri oleh Team Rocket, dan dalam proses mengambilnya kembali, kamu jatuh dari pesawat...
reviewPlot_ph: Ninakaw ng Team Rocket ang rebultong Milotic, at sa pagsubok na mabawi ito, kayo'y nahulog mula sa eroplano...
reviewPlot_ma: Patung Milotic telah dicuri oleh Team Rocket, dan semasa mencuba untuk mendapatkannya kembali, anda terjatuh dari kapal terbang…

reviewPlot: With Milotic's help, you defeated Team Rocket and won the final victory in the summer festival adventure!

reviewPlot_en: With Milotic's help, you defeated Team Rocket and won the final victory in the summer festival adventure!

reviewPlot_in: Dengan bantuan Milotic, kamu mengalahkan Team Rocket dan meraih kemenangan akhir dalam acara penjelajahan festival musim panas!
